WITH sl AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'c' ELSE 'p' END per,
    sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
  GROUP BY 1,2),
rt AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN r.return_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'c' ELSE 'p' END per, sum(r.refund_net) ret, count(*) nret
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
  GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (
  SELECT store_id, CASE WHEN business_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'c' ELSE 'p' END per, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rp_gross, sum(returns_net) rp_ret, sum(net_sales) rp_net, count(*) nd
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE store_id<900 AND (business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
  GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name,
  pg.gross_net p_gross, cg.gross_net c_gross, pg.staff p_staff, cg.staff c_staff,
  pr.ret p_ret, cr.ret c_ret, prp.rp_gross p_rp_gross, crp.rp_gross c_rp_gross, prp.rp_ret p_rp_ret, crp.rp_ret c_rp_ret, prp.nd p_nd, crp.nd c_nd
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900) st
LEFT JOIN sl pg ON pg.store_id=st.store_id AND pg.per='p' LEFT JOIN sl cg ON cg.store_id=st.store_id AND cg.per='c'
LEFT JOIN rt pr ON pr.store_id=st.store_id AND pr.per='p' LEFT JOIN rt cr ON cr.store_id=st.store_id AND cr.per='c'
LEFT JOIN rp prp ON prp.store_id=st.store_id AND prp.per='p' LEFT JOIN rp crp ON crp.store_id=st.store_id AND crp.per='c'
ORDER BY 1

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'c' ELSE 'p' END per, f.net_amount AS amt, f.staff_purchase_flag AS staff
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN r.return_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'c' ELSE 'p' END, -r.refund_net, NULL
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
), per_store AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(CASE WHEN per='c' THEN amt END) cur, sum(CASE WHEN per='p' THEN amt END) pri,
         sum(CASE WHEN per='c' AND coalesce(staff,false) THEN amt END) cur_staff, sum(CASE WHEN per='p' AND coalesce(staff,false) THEN amt END) pri_staff
  FROM lines GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'main' v, count(*) n, sum(cur) cur, sum(pri) pri, round((sum(cur)/sum(pri)-1)*100, 3) g FROM per_store WHERE cur IS NOT NULL AND pri IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'excl_136_137', count(*), sum(cur), sum(pri), round((sum(cur)/sum(pri)-1)*100, 3) FROM per_store WHERE cur IS NOT NULL AND pri IS NOT NULL AND store_id NOT IN (136,137)
UNION ALL SELECT 'excl_staff', count(*), sum(cur-coalesce(cur_staff,0)), sum(pri-coalesce(pri_staff,0)), round((sum(cur-coalesce(cur_staff,0))/sum(pri-coalesce(pri_staff,0))-1)*100, 3) FROM per_store WHERE cur IS NOT NULL AND pri IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'excl_136_137_125', count(*), sum(cur), sum(pri), round((sum(cur)/sum(pri)-1)*100, 3) FROM per_store WHERE cur IS NOT NULL AND pri IS NOT NULL AND store_id NOT IN (136,137,125)
UNION ALL SELECT 'all_incl_129', count(*), sum(coalesce(cur,0)), sum(pri), round((sum(coalesce(cur,0))/sum(pri)-1)*100, 3) FROM per_store

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'c' ELSE 'p' END AS per, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN r.return_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'c' ELSE 'p' END, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
), per_store AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(CASE WHEN per = 'c' THEN amt END) AS cur_net, sum(CASE WHEN per = 'p' THEN amt END) AS prior_net
  FROM lines GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, round((sum(cur_net) / sum(prior_net) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct
FROM per_store WHERE cur_net IS NOT NULL AND prior_net IS NOT NULL
